title: Sparkly kite
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- kite body - diamond shape -->
  <polygon points="50,12 78,42 50,72 22,42" fill="#FF4466" stroke="#FF8899" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- kite cross bars -->
  <line x1="50" y1="12" x2="50" y2="72" stroke="#FFCC00" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="42" x2="78" y2="42" stroke="#FFCC00" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- kite left section -->
  <polygon points="50,12 22,42 50,42" fill="#FF6688" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- kite right section -->
  <polygon points="50,12 50,42 78,42" fill="#FF3355" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- kite bottom left section -->
  <polygon points="22,42 50,42 50,72" fill="#FF5577" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- kite bottom right section -->
  <polygon points="50,42 78,42 50,72" fill="#EE2244" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- kite tail -->
  <path d="M50,72 Q48,80 44,84 Q40,88 36,86 Q32,84 34,90 Q36,96 30,96" fill="none" stroke="#FFCC00" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tail bows -->
  <polygon points="44,78 40,74 36,78 40,82" fill="#66EEFF" stroke="#99FFFF" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <polygon points="38,84 34,80 30,84 34,88" fill="#66FF99" stroke="#99FFCC" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <polygon points="34,92 30,88 26,92 30,96" fill="#FF99FF" stroke="#FFCCFF" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFEE44" stroke="#FFFFAA" stroke-width="0.5">
    <!-- sparkle 1 top left -->
    <polygon points="14,16 16,22 22,24 16,26 14,32 12,26 6,24 12,22"/>
    <!-- sparkle 2 top right -->
    <polygon points="82,10 84,15 89,17 84,19 82,24 80,19 75,17 80,15"/>
    <!-- sparkle 3 right -->
    <polygon points="88,52 89,56 93,57 89,58 88,62 87,58 83,57 87,56"/>
    <!-- sparkle 4 bottom left -->
    <polygon points="10,62 12,66 16,67 12,68 10,72 8,68 4,67 8,66"/>
    <!-- sparkle 5 bottom right -->
    <polygon points="72,82 74,86 78,87 74,88 72,92 70,88 66,87 70,86"/>
    <!-- sparkle 6 left -->
    <polygon points="6,38 7,41 10,42 7,43 6,46 5,43 2,42 5,41"/>
    <!-- sparkle 7 top center -->
    <polygon points="62,4 63,7 66,8 63,9 62,12 61,9 58,8 61,7"/>
  </g>
  <!-- small dot sparkles -->
  <g fill="#88FFFF">
    <circle cx="20" cy="50" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="80" cy="70" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="68" cy="20" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="30" cy="30" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="24" cy="76" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="86" cy="30" r="1.2"/>
  </g>
</svg>
